scope.status: Pending user review; not an approved replacement or publication.
scope.provenance: User-pinned Shadowland and .impeccable/references/desk-computer.png; launcher exit 126 fallback recorded in brief.md. No FORM seed, quality card, or detector report.
scope.tonalRamps: Generated panel aids only; not implemented palette steps.
scope.componentSpecimens: Static, self-contained examples of actual components. App state is not emulated. Preview variables are locally scoped, so snippets resolve literals.

accessibility.navigation: Skip link, focusable main landmark, translated icon-only names, current navigation attributes.
accessibility.architecture: Labeled static SVG, aria-live polite atomic readout, aria-pressed step selection, pointer-transparent decorative layers.
accessibility.fallback: SVG signal strokes when WebGL is unavailable; text and controls remain independent.
accessibility.reducedMotion: CSS transitions and animations removed; document scrolling becomes automatic; signal renders its target immediately.

socialProfiles.placement: Introduction and shared footer, with external-link icons.

assets.steadymd: Official corporate mark; do not label it a verified historical app icon or replace it with the renamed Lemonaid listing.
assets.functionalIcons: Existing inline stroked SVG paths in src/components/Icon.tsx and Preview.tsx; no glyph icons.

narrative.overview:
This document describes only the implemented interactive layout at `?preview=revision`. It is pending the user’s review; it does not approve replacement of `/` or publication. Root `DESIGN.md` and root `.impeccable/design.json` record the original light site and remain preserved. They are a separate visual world, not drift to repair in this pass.

The user pinned Shadowland and the supplied desk-computer reference. The preview translates those references into charcoal reading surfaces, restrained Manrope typography, authentic colored app identities, and an isometric console whose physical modules explain engineering responsibilities. The direction comes from that explicit brief, not a generated comp: the launcher failed with exit 126 and the documented fallback was used. No FORM seed, QUALITY BAR card, or detector report exists.
keyCharacteristics: A dark, mostly flat reading surface with fine dividers.
A career timeline and contribution stories, with a separate phone-shaped mobile workspace.
Physical depth concentrated in the console and phone; brand assets retain their colors.
English and Spanish share the same hierarchy and navigation.

rules.name: The Scoped Preview Rule
rules.body: Treat these values as evidence for the revision route only until the user approves a broader change.

rules.name: The Reading First Rule
rules.body: Keep the explanatory text and controls usable independently of the physical figure and its light trace.

rules.name: The Physical Depth Rule
rules.body: Use grounding shadows for tangible objects and their housings; keep ordinary editorial rows flat.

dos: Do keep the preview boundary and pending-review status explicit.
Do use the provided portrait and verified brand assets with their established identity.
Do keep the contribution story before its optional fictional-data demo.
Do preserve visible focus, semantic controls, translated names, static signal fallback, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do keep conceptual architecture separate from claims about production infrastructure.
donts: Don't replace the root design documents or publish this preview as an approved site.
Don't substitute letter avatars, emoji, or invented company marks for the verified brand assets.
Don't turn the reference’s surrounding social/video interface into portfolio decoration.
Don't generalize the inherited light demo surfaces into the preview’s page palette.
Don't invent a FORM seed, quality card, detector result, or user approval.
